title: Eight Ball Champ

evidence.layout: Pointer table at CPU $EE30, 62 phrases, command-ordered, with a final end bound.
evidence.independent_check: The board's own firmware was run and the byte stream it sends the TMS captured and located back in the ROM. It plays 34 streams from 33 distinct addresses spanning $D000-$EDB5. Every one of those streams falls inside a phrase this layout converts.
evidence.conversion: 1485 frames converted, all keeping their frame kind when the output was re-parsed with the target tables.
evidence.emulation: The converted devices were loaded into a simulation of the Squawk & Talk board, which booted and issued the same 24 SPEAK EXTERNAL commands as the original set.
evidence.not_verified: No converted ROM from this profile has been played on a real board. Nobody has heard it.
evidence.phrases_not_observed: The layout declares 5 phrase(s) the trace never saw played ($DFBD, $E04E, $E0C8, $E13E, $E2A1). They are table entries like any other and convert the same way; the commands that reach them are simply not among those the simulation issues.

notes: This sound ROM set is shared by 1 game revisions: eballchp.
